summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 41 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: In San Francisco’s A.I. Era, Even $180,000 Tech Salaries Are No Longer Enough
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Webinar: Why business email compromise attacks keep succeeding
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours
